[size=4]I've been honing my skills and growing an audience on Social Medias. The problem is that I [/size]

[size=4]my previous level, and keep enjoying this. This is kind of a heartbreak for me because I wanted to [/size]
[size=4]finish this mod so bad, and I wanted it in my game !! But this takes SO MUCH time, [/size]
[size=4]and currently I'm trying to become a professional artist and training in my free time, to make money[/size]
[size=4]and earn a living. [/size]

[size=4]It's with a heavy heart that I'm putting this on pause for now. Maybe in the future I'll redo them all ? [/size]
[size=4]I won't do another set of promises, I am a person of my word but I just didn't conceive what I would do in the future, [/size]
[size=4]which is now, and please understand that I am sorry because I got a lot of feedback from you all being happy about this. [/size]

[size=4]It's just too much and too different from what I'm doing right now, but I really really hope I can come back to this. [/size]
[size=4]Who know ? Make it better maybe ? I'm hoping for the best. [/size]

[size=4]And in the meanwhile take care, thank you a lot for your support, stay safe. [/size]

[size=4]See you ! [/size]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
Ever since I played Stardew Valley I loved the game, and I was heavily disappointed by Harvest Moon series, for personal reasons/taste. So It's always a delight to re-discover and mod the game anew, and I always wanted to do the portraits myself. I also found few portraits covering the entire population of the game, which I liked (I liked this one, but it's not exhaustive, and then this one... but not this... and then the art is not coherent troughout the population of the Valley... and then how about HD with Portraiture, but though DC Burger drawings are nice it's not my cup of tea... [size=1]the list goes on and no one cares[/size]).

So I made my own compilation and downloaded here and there, but then... how about making it myself ? So there it is. At last, I gathered the motivation to do it. I will also use them in my game once finished, probably, if I'm not to harsh on my own art XD that was the main reason why I started this mod. 

[u]How I proceed[/u] : I take inspiration from the sprites (the ones with them on the map, not the main portraits), and I do them with a touch of my tastes, a bit of my art style, a spray of manga/cute girl/gentleman inspiration, and respect towards how it [i]could[/i] look, with that sprite in mind. I take slight liberties, but it sticks well overall to the vanilla sprites (my interpretation on them, anyway). So things like Abigail bow is there, Harvey doesn't have a moustache (he doesn't on his sprite), Alex has more tamed hair, Sam has earrings, etc... all examples of sticking to the sprite, and my interpretation of the character. 

[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[/size]- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿

[u]Note[/u] : The Smapi and Portraiture requirements are from the "Portraiture" mod, but technically... yeah, they're required, so...

[b][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]
Extract the zip contents to this location :
[i]C:\...Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits[/i]

[u]Notes[/u] :
- Keep the "SolaLuuka" folder inside of the "Portraits" folder, from the "Portraiture" mod,
don't delete "SolaLuuka" and put the portraits directly inside of "Portraits", or it will not work.
- "Portraiture" is the base name of the folder for the mod "Portraiture", it may change if you changed the name when downloading their mod.
